title: Time-Dependent Voronoi Analysis of Amino Acid Side-Chain Packing in Simulations.
one_liner_zh: 该文利用Voro++对分子动力学轨迹进行时间依赖的Voronoi分析，追踪氨基酸侧链堆积动态，以探测蛋白质构象变化前的细微结构变化，属于蛋白质结构计算模拟的应用性方法研究。
abstract: Protein conformational motion depends on geometric and chemical constraints in side-chain packing. Thermal forces and incomplete packing produce "breathing" motions that allow internal rearrangement. Packing dynamics therefore inform protein allostery, conformational change, and folding. While Voronoi tessellation is a promising approach to this end, its application to proteins has been mainly focused on static structures. Here, the Voro++ library is adopted to investigate time-dependent amino acid packing in molecular dynamics trajectories of a titin immunoglobulin domain at 300 and 400 K. Tracking per-residue Voronoi volume changes and reorganization of neighbor faces in the Voronoi lattice reveals residue-level volume shifts and the corresponding timing of localized protein swelling. Side-chain motion into and out of the protein core can also be monitored by mapping neighbor switching. This framework is applicable to detecting delicate changes preceding protein conformational transition or unfolding, and analyzing protein-protein interface reorganization or surface hydration.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质构象运动取决于侧链堆积中的几何与化学约束。热力与不完全堆积产生“呼吸”运动，允许内部重排。因此，堆积动力学为蛋白质变构、构象变化和折叠提供信息。虽然Voronoi镶嵌是实现此目的的一种有前景的方法，但其在蛋白质中的应用主要集中于静态结构。在此，采用Voro++库研究titin免疫球蛋白结构域在300和400 K下分子动力学轨迹中时间依赖的氨基酸堆积。追踪每个残基的Voronoi体积变化及Voronoi晶格中邻居面的重组，揭示了残基水平的体积变化及局部蛋白质膨胀的相应时间。侧链运动进出蛋白质核心也可通过映射邻居切换来监测。该框架适用于检测蛋白质构象转变或去折叠前的细微变化，并分析蛋白质-蛋白质界面重组或表面水合作用。
